== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Hunter-ships are unmanned, wedge-shaped vessels characterized by a silver, insectoid carapace. These ships possess significant firepower capable of destroying personal starships in one volley and are highly maneuverable over short distances. Beyond their physical armament, they utilize magic that broadcasts their recent experiences upon [[destruction]]. In combat, they often appear in large formations or rows, sometimes accompanied by black-and-white clones. While standard defenses can manage real Hunter-ships without these copies, the presence of the cloned versions significantly increases their threat level. They are associated with the [[Legion]] and have been observed attacking settlements in organized waves.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Hunter-ships are a group of five distinct vessels characterized by their silvery, wedge-shaped forms. These ships are encased in a shell-like insect carapace and possess the ability to multiply, often appearing as silver teeth. Beyond their physical appearance, these vessels hold the potential to choke space with [[plasma]].}}
